title: Replay agreement on the same machine and build
objective: A replay of a recorded run reproduces it exactly on the same machine and build

primary_metric.name: identity
primary_metric.definition: every comparison bitwise equal: per-step state digests (time, qpos, qvel, act, qacc_warmstart) and measurement values

references: SIMLAB test plan F5 (identity on the same machine and build)
model_assumptions: same machine and same build only (test plan Rules); seeds, recorded actions and checkpoints come from SIMLAB's own records.

variants.task: Controlled pendulum with a seeded noisy controller and a random start angle.
A box dropped onto a box from a random height (contact-rich).
Two controller gains (a factor) with a normally distributed start angle.

grading: referee/criteria.json via oracle.py (stdlib only, run in a separate isolated interpreter)
